name: Memory Context - Zero-Shift Context Engine
description: Advanced memory plugin for OpenClaw with JIT hierarchical assembly, tiered persistence, shift-immunity safeguards, and observability.

mode.description: Context assembly mode: JIT (recommended), adaptive, or strict preservation

hierarchyLevels.description: Number of context hierarchy levels (L0-L4 default)

targetUtilization.description: Target token window utilization with a default safety reserve

enableShiftImmunity.description: Enable context shift immunity across model switches and restarts

enablePredictiveAssembly.description: Pre-assemble likely next contexts based on conversation patterns

enableQuantumAnchors.description: Use typed anchors for context continuity

retentionPolicy.description: How to handle context growth across tiers

compactionMode.description: Compaction is disabled; context is rebuilt from source using JIT assembly

autoDetectModel.description: Automatically detect model and configure context window

semanticWeight.description: Weight for semantic vs token-based context selection

workingMemorySize.description: Number of recent interactions in working memory (L0)

enableHeuristicScoring.description: Use advanced heuristics for content scoring and relevance

enableContextDiff.description: Track and report what changed between context builds

persistFullHistory.description: Persist complete conversation history for deterministic rebuilding
